newsitem.title: UK: LCE white sugar lightly mixed as switches prevail.
newsitem.headline: LCE white sugar lightly mixed as switches prevail.

text.p: White sugar futures remained lightly mixed in heavy afternoon trading but activity was dominated by crossed switch dealings as the London market ignored the reappearance of the New York raws, traders said.
By 1628 GMT turnover totalled a hefty 3,791 lots, mainly composed of crossed October against actuals trades and good October/December spread trading.
October stood down 40 cents at $349.90, with a solid contract volume of 1,872 lots. December was up just 10 cents at $346.10.

"There's been good switch volume throughout the day between $3.50 and $4.50," one trader said, adding that a London commission house had been actively dealing the spread after the New York open. Other commission house and bank crossing of the nearby positions boosted the overall volume, traders said.

The Paris market saw a similar trading pattern, with the spot October contract accounting for the bulk of the 1,546-lot volume. October was down 60 cents at $349.90 and December was unchanged but bid at $346.00.
